title: Small open neighbourhoods of null sets for a measure finite on compact subsets of U
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N, U ⊆ ℝ^N open with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, Z ⊆ U an arbitrary set with μ(Z) = 0, and ζ ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is an open set O ⊆ ℝ^N with Z ⊆ O ⊆ U and μ(O) < ζ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U Z : Set (Euclidean N)) (ζ : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → Z ⊆ U → μ Z = 0 → 0 < ζ → ∃ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsOpen O ∧ Z ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ U ∧ μ O < ζ
